title: Per-resource embedding config lookup: EmbeddingConfigRegistry.For(gvr)
answers: Where do I get the embeddable fields declared for a resource's app manifest?
How is the SDK's embed declaration (fields + reembedVersion) exposed to unified storage?
Is there a registry mapping GVR to embedding config, like the search fields registry?
body: App-SDK embed declarations (per-kind ManifestVersionKindEmbed.Fields plus the resource-level ManifestResourceEmbed.ReembedVersion) are consolidated into pkg/storage/unified/resource/embedding_config.go:EmbeddingConfigRegistry, built from builtin resource.AppManifests() plus live watcher manifests (live replaces a resource's config entirely, including API versions it doesn't redeclare). Look up via EmbeddingConfigRegistry.For(gvr) — requires the exact stored apiVersion; returns (config, false) when no embed declaration exists, vs (emptyFields, true) when one exists with zero fields. Reachable from resource.SearchOptions.EmbeddingConfig, constructed only when cfg.EnableSearch or cfg.VectorIndexingEnabled in pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go:NewSearchOptions. Builder selection and actual embedding generation are out of scope here — this PR only exposes the config.
applies: Code that needs to know which fields to embed for a resource/version, or the resource's re-embedding revision, e.g. embedding generation or backfill built on unified storage.
says: Where are the embedded fields declared for a resource type
How do I look up which fields are marked as embeddable for a resource
Registry that maps resource types to their embedding field declarations
Where is the registry listing which fields can be embedded for each resource
How to find the embedding configuration for a specific resource kind
search: EmbeddingConfigRegistry.For(gvr) retrieves embedding field configs by exact apiVersion, distinguishing no-declaration (config, false) from zero-field-declaration (emptyFields, true). The registry consolidates App-SDK ManifestVersionKindEmbed.Fields and ReembedVersion from builtin and live-watched manifests, where live configs replace a resource's declaration entirely. Access occurs only via resource.SearchOptions.EmbeddingConfig when cfg.EnableSearch or cfg.VectorIndexingEnabled in NewSearchOptions. Applies to determining which fields to embed for a resource, embedding generation, or unified-storage backfill operations. Key locations: pkg/storage/unified/resource/embedding_config.go:EmbeddingConfigRegistry and pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go:NewSearchOptions.
